Welcome to the Apex Legends x Cyberpunk Event, where the neon lights of E-District beckon in Wildcard and Cyberware floods the streets. But be careful: reports of Cyberpsychosis are on the rise. Hunt down the Mythic Skippy Alternator and Iconic Legend skins, and earn Eddies throughout the event to spend in the Reward Shop.

The Apex Legends x Cyberpunk Event goes live July 14.

Learn more: http://x.ea.com/apxl/cyberpunk-event

Apex Legends™ is a free-to-play* battle royale game where legendary characters battle for glory, fame, and fortune on the fringes of the Frontier. Play for free now on PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Xbox® One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch™ 2, and PC via EA App, Epic Games Store and Steam: http://x.ea.com/57366.

Check out our YouTube channel: http://x.ea.com/56710
Follow us on X: https://twitter.com/playapex
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playapex/
Follow us on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@playapex/

Credits:
Production company: Electronic Arts & Dark Burn Creative
Sound design and mix: Respawn Entertainment & Mass Audio
All other categories: Electronic Arts & Respawn Entertainment

*Applicable platform account and platform subscription (sold separately) may be required. Persistent internet connection and EA Account required. Age restrictions apply. This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

snippet.title: Ve Junoon | Awarapan 2 | Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani | Vishesh Bhatt | Mithoon, Sayeed Q., Subodhh
snippet.description:
Phir ishq karne chala kyun?
 
Beginning the musical journey of ‘Awarapan 2’, ‘Ve Junoon’ is composed by Mithoon, sung by Subodhh Sharma and penned by Sayeed Quadri. Featuring Emraan Hashmi and Disha Patani in the video, this song is yearning in its purest form.
 
#VeJunoon #Awarapan2 #EmraanHashmi #DishaPatani #Mithoon #SayeedQuadri #SubodhhSharma
 
Song Composed and Arranged by Mithoon
Lyrics: Sayeed Quadri
Singer: Subodhh Sharma
Song Creative Head: Anugrah
Music Production: Godswill Mergulhão
Music Assistants: Anugrah, Godswill Mergulhão, Eli Rodrigues & Kaushal Gohil
Guitars: Kalyan Baruah
Violin: Jitu Thakur
Backing Vocals: Abhishek Nailwal, Mihir Sharma & Kaustubh More
Recorded at Livingwater Music by A Manivannan
Song Mixed & Mastered by Eric Pillai at Future Sound of Bombay
Assistant Mixing Engineer: Michael Edwin Pillai
Music Head Vishesh Films: Rohit Saini
 
Starring Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani, Shabana Azmi, Suvinder Vicky, Vijayant Kohli, Aniruddh Rawal, Atul Kumar
 
Vishesh Films & Mukesh Bhatt Present
A Vishesh Bhatt Production
 
AWARAPAN 2
Produced By Vishesh Bhatt
Directed By Nitin Kakkar
Director of Photography Vishnu Rao
Editor Devendra Murdeshwar
Production Designer Teena Paradkar
Choreographer Mudassar Khan
 
Theatrical Distribution Pen Marudhar
In Cinemas 14th August 2026
 
Lyrics:

Intro
 
Chaha tha tune jisse Paaya kabhi na usse
 
Tujhko toh sab hai pataa, aye dil Saari khabar hai tujhe
 
Banjar hui hai aankhen Veeran hai ye saansen
Ab meri rooh ko na jalaa...naa jalaa
 
Aage hai teri marzi Karle tu ye khudgarzi
Hona hai hojaa tabaah...haan tabaah
 
Chorus
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil lutne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil mitne chalaa kyun..haaye
 
Phir Ishq karne chalaa kyun OOOOOOOOO..
Dil lutne chalaa kyun OOOOOOOOO..
Dil mitne chalaa kyun..haaye Phir Ishq karne chala kyun…
 
( Music )
 
OOOOOOOOOO.. OOOOOOOOOO..
 
Verse 1
 
Dekha hai pehle kahin Aisa laga kyun usse
 
Shaayad mere dard se kahin Waqif laga woh mujhe
 
Marham laga zakhmon pe Raahat mili kuchh phirse
Dil ko sukoon milaa..haan milaaaa
 
Aage hai teri marzi Karle tu ye khudgarzi
Hona hai hojaa tabaah...haan tabaah
 
Chorus
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil lutne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil mitne chalaa kyun, haaye
 
Phir Ishq karne chalaa kyun…
 
(Music)
 
Tararareiyeee yeeeeee…
 
Verse 2
 
Aisi koi daastaan
Hai dil main uske kahin Zikr woh jiska kabhi magar Khud se bhi karta nahin
 
Rakhta chhupa ke sabse Bhulaa hai jaise rakh ke
Kal woh kahin apna…..apnaaa Aage hai teri marzi
 
Karle tu ye khudgarzi
Hona hai hojaa tabaah...haan tabaah
 
Chorus
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil lutne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil mitne chalaa kyun….haaye
 
Phir ishq karne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junooooooooooooooo Oooooooooo Oooooooooo Ooooooooooo
Ve Junooooooooooooooo Oooooooooo Oooooooooo Ooooooooooo
 
Dil ishq karne chalaa kyun Hmmmmmm…..
Phir ishq karne chalaa kyun

snippet.title: The Mystery of Thebes | Marvel Rivals Season 9 Trailer | Marvel Rivals
snippet.description:
Unveil the mysteries hidden within the ancient world of Thebes with Season 9 of Marvel Rivals! 🏛️ 

As Apocalypse journeyed across a collapsing timeline, destiny drove him to collide with enemies old and new. But as faith deals a deadly hand, no one truly knows who can be trusted. 

A storm builds as a single mother attempts to put together the pieces of what was left behind. Help her track down an even more impenetrable shadow looming over newly uncovered murder mysteries. 

Sift through endless lies and uncover the one truth with Marvel Rivals Season 9: The Mystery of Thebes on July 10 UTC! 🔎

About YRF Spy Universe: 
YRF Spy Universe is a first of its kind cinematic universe of spy thriller films in India. The first film in the universe, "Ek Tha Tiger", starring Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif was released in 2012, followed by its sequel "Tiger Zinda Hai" in 2017. The third film in the universe, "War" was released in 2019 and starred Hrithik Roshan and Tiger Shroff in pivotal roles. "Pathaan" was the fourth instalment in the Spy Universe franchise which was released in 2023 starring Shah Rukh Khan, Deepika Padukone and John Abraham. "Tiger 3", the fifth instalment in the YRF Spy Universe and the third film in the Tiger series, starring Salman Khan, Katrina Kaif and Emraan Hashmi, released in 2023. "War 2", the sixth film in the YRF Spy Universe, starring Hrithik Roshan, NTR and Kiara Advani, directed by Ayan Mukerji, released on 14 August 2025. "Alpha", the seventh film in the franchise and Hindi cinema’s first female-led YRF Spy Universe film, starring Alia Bhatt and Sharvari, released on 3 July 2026.

snippet.title: Dinosaurs of the Wild West | Official Kickstarter Trailer (4K)
snippet.description:
Worldwide Pre-Order on Kickstarter Now: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sparkefilms/dinosaurs-of-the-wild-west-series

From the creative team behind the 2025 cult-dinosaur feature PRIMITIVE WAR comes an ambitious new original cinematic universe: DINOSAURS OF THE WILD WEST.

In an alternate frontier, humanity navigates a dangerous land where every journey, every town, and every war depends on the giant creatures that shaped civilization itself. Dinosaurs of the Wild West is an epic adventure series that reimagines the American frontier through a world millions of years in the making.

Massive Brontosaurs haul entire towns across the frontier.
Raptors are ridden into battle.
Pterosaurs rule the skies.

For generations, humans and dinosaurs shaped the world together.
Now something is coming that threatens to change that forever.

Narrated by actor Jesse Kove. Inspired by the illustrated world of creator Shaun Keenan. 

Alongside the full trailer, DINOSAURS OF THE WILD WEST Kickstarter campaign unveils  a mix of EARLY BIRD and LIMITED EDITION rewards that include:
 VIP ON SET EXPERIENCES
 FIRST EDITION TRADING CARD SET
 BEHIND THE SCENES ACCESS
 ASSOCIATE PRODUCER CREDITS
 And the opportunity to CREATE A DINOSAUR for the series.

Stretch goals for the campaign include expanded creature sequences, additional cinematic set pieces, major guest appearances, and the unlocking of future episodes. 

Currently the ONLY way to watch is to pre order the series through kickstarter. 

ABOUT THE PROJECT
Dinosaurs of the Wild West is an original cinematic universe created by filmmaker Luke Sparke and developed alongside a team of artists and visual effects talent behind Primitive War and multiple internationally released feature films. It’s produced by Carmel Imrie, Carly Sparke and Luke Sparke with Executive Producers Geoff Imrie, Eric Weick, Colin Hurdle, Kelly Clifford, Luke Sparke

The two promos were completed in house by Luke Sparke, Sparke Films, Let It Be Entertainment and Sparke Effects including VFX artists Vivian David, Jared Johnson, Mark Griffiths, Julien Romeo, Felipe Gonzalez, Evan Robinson, Alejandro Agudelo and in conjunction with Kubo vfx studio. VFX Supervison by Luke Sparke, Post Produced by Carly Sparke, Executive Creative Brooke Marsden and original score by Frederik Wiedmann.

The Sallowlands beckon—immerse yourself into the world and characters of this new Daggerheart mini-series premiering July 9th! Rumors swirl of a gargantuan metropolis appearing suddenly, deep in the cracked ancient lakebed of the Sallowlands. Five survivors hope that finding it will give them what they each desperately need.

AGE OF UMBRA: SALLOWLANDS
A group of outcasts and survivors brave blasted lands in search of answers in Age of Umbra: Sallowlands. This 6-part Daggerheart mini-series features Game Master Matthew Mercer and players Laura Bailey, Jennifer English, Abubakar Salim, Vico Ortiz, and Zachery Renauldo. They’ll form an unlikely band of companions, who venture off the beaten path in search of answers in the Sallowlands, a new region of the Halcyon Domain filled with cracked badlands, dangers, and awe-inspiring secrets. snippet.title: Green Day - I'm Never Gonna R.I.P. (From the 'NIMRODS' Original Soundtrack) [Official Video]
snippet.description:
Listen to "I'm Never Gonna R.I.P.": https://GreenDay.lnk.to/ImNeverGonnaRIP 

The full NIMRODS soundtrack arrives July 31st, featuring Green Day, Analog Dogs, Mckenna Grace, The Paradox and Ultra Q. Pre-order it now: https://GreenDay.lnk.to/NimrodsOriginalSoundtrack

Want to see NIMRODS early? Join us for the global event screening on August 11th, featuring exclusive live bonus footage. 

International tickets go on sale July 14th for screenings from August 11, for a limited time only. Sign up for tickets on https://nimrodsmovie.com

Beginning August 14th, the film is set to hit theaters wide throughout the U.S. (ticket info coming soon). 

We'll see you at the movies! 

ABOUT NIMRODS

When Tommy receives a phone call inviting his band to open for Green Day on New Years Eve, he doesn’t realize it’s an elaborate prank by his older brother, Wayne. Desperate to believe his life is about to change, Tommy steals Wayne's car and begins driving his band from Kansas City to Los Angeles, hell bent on getting there in three days. What follows is a rowdy and uproarious road trip across America, inspired by Green Day’s early days of touring in a van, years before the release of their breakout record Dookie. 

Starring: Mason Thames, Kylr Coffman, Ryan Foust, and Mckenna Grace.

Also Starring: Jenna Fischer, Angela Kinsey,  Fred Armisen, Bobby Lee, Jolene, Keen Ruffalo, Ignacio Diaz-Silverio, Sean Gunn. 

With Green Day: Billie Joe Armstrong, Mike Dirnt, and Tré Cool.

snippet.description:
One boxer's fight for revenge turns out to be the biggest battle of his life. Watch the official trailer for #Fightland, from Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson. Step into the ring July 31 only on STARZ. 

#STARZ #Fightland 

Subscribe to the STARZ YouTube Channel: http://bit.ly/1kalhP0

Facebook: http://starz.tv/STARZFacebookYT
Instagram: http://starz.tv/STARZInstagramYT
YouTube: https://starz.tv/STARZYouTube
TikTok: https://starz.tv/STARZTikTokYT

When newly crowned British-born heavyweight boxing champion Duke Kilroy sees his brother
die in a frenzied assault, Duke snaps. After spending eight years in a U.S. prison, he returns
home to London seeking vengeance against the man he believes set him up – criminal kingpin,
and his former promoter, Kingsley Marshall. But Kingsley has disappeared, leaving his children
and his wife, Joy (the love of Duke’s life), to pick up the pieces. Working with a cartel desperate
to control London’s drug market, Duke begins a high-risk game to infiltrate Kingsley’s empire
and destroy it from within. And when Kingsley returns, Duke will take his revenge.

snippet.title: Simply Red - Holding Back The Years (Live at Old Trafford 1996)
snippet.description:
On 29th June 1996 Simply Red performed at Old Trafford Stadium in Manchester to 60,000 fans as part of the ‘Euro '96 Extravaganza’, to celebrate the final match of the UEFA Euro ’96 Championship. 

'Holding Back the Years: 40 Years of Simply Red, Live in Santiago' is out now: https://simplyred.lnk.to/LiveInSantiagoYT

Simply Red are thrilled to announce 'Recollections', their brand-new album celebrating 40 incredible years! Featuring 40 newly recorded versions of their most loved songs, the album is available digitally, on 4LP vinyl, as a 3CD set, and as a 2LP highlights edition, out now: https://SimplyRed.lnk.to/RecollectionsYT

Subscribe to Simply Red - https://www.youtube.com/@simplyred/featured?sub_confirmation=1

Follow Simply Red:
https://www.facebook.com/simplyred/
https://twitter.com/SimplyRedHQ
https://instagram.com/simplyredofficial
https://www.tiktok.com/@simplyredofficial
https://www.threads.net/@simplyredofficial

Simply Red have over a billion hits on YouTube, have sold over 60 million albums worldwide, 5 going to number one in the UK. Their 1991 classic Stars was the best-selling album for two years running in Britain and Europe. They have had two US Billboard chart toppers with classic singles Holding Back The Years and If You Don’t Know Me By Now. Every Simply Red studio album has been a UK top ten (with previous release Big Love reaching number 4 in 2015). Hucknall has been the songwriter and bandleader since the beginning in 1985.

I've wasted all my tears

And nothing had the chance to be good
Nothing ever could yeah, oh

I'll keep holding on
I'll keep holding on
I'll keep holding on
I'll keep holding on
So tight

I've wasted all my tears
Wasted all of those years
And nothing had the chance to be good

Holding, holding, holding

That's all I have today
It's all I have to say

snippet.description:

A heartfelt dancehall breakup anthem about two lovers watching a once beautiful relationship fall apart. Love Done Dead blends modern dancehall, reggae fusion, and soulful Caribbean melodies into an emotional story filled with regret, memories, and feelings that never truly disappear.




Popcaan and Shenseea deliver emotional performances as two hearts struggle to let go after love fades. With honest storytelling, relatable lyrics, and a memorable singalong chorus, Love Done Dead captures the pain of missing someone who was once your everything.




Perfect for late night listening, heartbreak playlists, emotional moments, and lovers of smooth Caribbean music.




Expect:

• Emotional breakup storytelling

• Catchy singalong chorus

• Smooth dancehall and reggae fusion vibes

• Powerful male and female chemistry

Thanks to Alienware for sponsoring DF Direct. To learn more about the Alienware AREA-51 Gaming Desktop, check out: http://aw.gg/digitalfoundry

One part necessary re-organisation, one part liberation for key developers, one part vandalism of Xbox studios, it's a mixture of disbelief and anger from the DF panel as the full extent of Xbox's so-called "reset" becomes clear. If Asha Sharma's report on the business is on the level, clearly something had to be done - but as the scale of the lay-offs and the astonishing cuts to id Software become clear, are spreadsheets now more important to Microsoft than its audience?

Examine the DF Website: https://digitalfoundry.net

Subscribe for more Digital Foundry: http://bit.ly/DFSubscribe

0:00:00 Introduction 
0:02:14 Supporter Q1: Why is Microsoft laying off 3200 people?
0:30:02 Supporter Q2: Will Sony be forced to be more flexible with their digital storefront, now that physical discs are on the way out?
0:46:27 Supporter Q3: Should Microsoft and Sony just call their next-gen consoles off?
0:56:11 Supporter Q4: Could the PS6 SoC be revised?
1:01:42 Supporter Q5: Could you use PCIe expansion to attach graphics expansion tech to current consoles?

‣ MINECRAFT DIMENSION: https://bit.ly/3mKfUOL

Minecraft is an open world game that has no specific goals for the player to accomplish, allowing players a large amount of freedom in choosing how to play the game however, there is an achievement system. The gameplay by default is first person, but players have the option to play in third person mode. The core gameplay revolves around breaking and placing blocks. The game world is essentially composed of rough 3D objects—mainly cubes—that are arranged in a fixed grid pattern and represent different materials, such as dirt, stone, various ores, water, and tree trunks. While players can move freely across the world, objects and items can only be placed at fixed locations relative to the grid. Players can gather these material blocks and place them elsewhere, thus allowing for various constructions.

On this channel, you’ll find long-form video essays about gaming’s biggest stories from studio collapses and corporate greed to the creative risks that still push the medium forward. I break down industry trends, publisher decisions, and the economics behind how games are made, marketed, and sold.

Whether it’s GTA 6, Elden Ring, Baldur's Gate 3, Path of Exile 2, Call of Duty, Battlefield, Pokémon, or the next doomed live-service experiment, I cover how the industry’s biggest names keep shaping and breaking the games we play.

snippet.title: NEW LEAK says Sony SHOCKED by Backlash! No Plan for FUTURE OF PLAYSTATION!
snippet.description:
Follow me on social media:
Instagram: http://instagram.com/dreamcastguy
Patreon: patreon.com/DreamcastGuy
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/thedreamcastguy

Sony announced they're done with physical games starting in 2028. 

There's a pretty good chance I won't be getting the PS6 at this point 
#PlayStation6 #PS6 #ps5 


The complete disregard and disrespect for the fans who care deeply about physical PS games might be the biggest slap to the face I've see from this company. Absolute joke. As consumer preferences and the broader entertainment industry continue to shift away from physical discs to digital, physical game disc production for all new games releasing on PlayStation consoles will be discontinued starting January 2028.  Following this date, new games will be available on PlayStation Store and at retailers in digital formats only. This transition has no impact on games that already released, or will be releasing, prior to January 2028 in disc format. Kojima has spoken in Rome about the end of PlayStation's physical format: I think PlayStation executives are so out of touch if they didn’t realize how bad this new would go down amongst some of their most hardcore fans. I was so shocked when they dropped the news just like everyone else.

I hope they can figure out something to make the situation better and not just ignore some of their most dedicated fans

"It makes me very sad, I'm buying lots of PS3 games so they don't get lost" this might genuinely be one of the biggest Gaming protest/drama/boycott ever to exist for a long time And you will see Sony hide behind today's Xbox news. This is where we are people. One greedy company hiding behind another greedy company's bad news to avoid addressing their own. It has now been 6 days since the PlayStation post: PlayStation hasn't posted in over 5 days on Twitter (X) 🎮

• Their longest span of not tweeting in years

• The post announcing they're ending physical game production currently has 8 approved Community Notes

- it's official the 4th most viewed biggest gaming post ever on Twitter/X (164m views, 1-3 are GTA 6 posts)
- SONY wanted to wait this out but people are not willing to forget
- This had created a Cultural phenomenon around the world
- More people than ever are speaking out on it

SONY messed up bad here, there is no alternative than to respond. No one will forget THIS!!! Xbox really just fired over 3 thousand ppl and sold off at least 4 of their 1st party studios, and it's still not as bad as that shit PlayStation announced last week. What a world. REPORT: PlayStation has apparently blindsided, and not told its publishers and business partners, and even branches in other markets, about cancelling physical games🚀

Sony reducing a legacy spanning multiple generations to mere three paragraph blog post that implies utter disdain for its audience is deranged to say the least🎤 

NO DISC 💿 NO BUY

snippet.title: My Thoughts On PlayStation Ending Physical Discs
snippet.description:
Sony has announced they're ending the production of physical discs for PlayStation consoles by January 2028. And while they have made it clear that reprints could occur, there's simply no getting around this being the end of what was such a core part of the hobby. And in the midst of all this, there's arguments about physical vs. digital splits, publisher desire, profits, used games, and the WHY of Sony is doing this. I'm here to argue, it's less about that. Numbers are numbers, but sometimes you do something as a goodwill initiative. And PlayStation has forgotten what it means to do something for the brand and the wider fandom. They just don't get it anymore. I also never understood the plot of Inception. But we're not here for that.

localized.title: My Thoughts On PlayStation Ending Physical Discs
localized.description:
Sony has announced they're ending the production of physical discs for PlayStation consoles by January 2028. And while they have made it clear that reprints could occur, there's simply no getting around this being the end of what was such a core part of the hobby. And in the midst of all this, there's arguments about physical vs. digital splits, publisher desire, profits, used games, and the WHY of Sony is doing this. I'm here to argue, it's less about that. Numbers are numbers, but sometimes you do something as a goodwill initiative. And PlayStation has forgotten what it means to do something for the brand and the wider fandom. They just don't get it anymore. I also never understood the plot of Inception. But we're not here for that.

Info about the map written by oxygendavid
Welcome to Witcombe Park Farm
📍 Inspired by the countryside of Gloucestershire, UK

🌄 A carefully crafted blend of real‑world geography and fictional design, creating a distinctive and authentic UK farming landscape.
🚜 60+ fields ranging from small paddocks to large arable expanses.
🗺️ 100+ purchasable farmlands, including extensive forestry plots and hidden woodland corners.
🐇 New animal: Rabbits
🐖🐄🐑 New British livestock breeds, each with their own stats: • Gloucestershire Old Spot (pigs) • Hereford & Jersey (cattle) • Suffolk, Bluefaced Leicester & Texel (sheep)
🌦️ Fully reworked environment XML featuring new weather patterns, lighting profiles, cloud systems, and a refreshed daytime skybox.
🌱 Completely redesigned UK style ground textures and foliage, giving the map a fresh, grounded visual identity. 🚂 Driveable Class 40 (UK) 🇬🇧 Step into the cab of a fully driveable British Rail Class 40 and experience true UK diesel‑electric power in action! 🔧⚡
Fire up the engine, take the controls, and enjoy driving one of Britain’s most iconic locomotives right inside the game. 🚆✨ Who’s taking it for a spin first 😄
🌲 High detail forest assets for a more realistic woodland experience.
🎧 Custom ambient soundscape tailored to the map’s environment.
🚗 New UK‑style traffic, including motorbikes, tractors, and articulated lorries.
🏡 4 fully developed main farms, each with their own character.
🏘️ 4+ small holdings, offering varied and immersive starting points.
🛠️ Full customization sellable farm buildings, removable junk piles, adjustable field borders, and more.
🎮 Designed to support every playstyle  from small scale realism to large scale contracting.

Multi Terrain Angle added 
🌾 14 New Crops Added 
📦 From PfalzAgrar Multi Prefab Pack (10):
Rye • Triticale • Spelt • Grain Maize • Green Rye • Vetch Rye • Field Grass • Silage Maize • Humus Activator • Mustard

🌼 Custom Crops (3):
Alfalfa • Linseed • Poppy

🏭 7 custom production chains integrated seamlessly into the map.
🍎 4 dedicated fruit sell points
🏪 10 additional sell points for productions, materials, and goods.
🧱 30+ new UK‑themed placeables
🏘️ Hundreds of high‑detail UK assets populating the world.


Music by Epidemic Sound

snippet.title: I Played Every World Cup Game Ever
snippet.description:
I should've been warned about Netflix FIFA😭

In this football/FIFA/Gaming/World Cup video, I played every World Cup game ever. I tried every single World Cup video game ever to see which one is best, and if they've gotten worse over time? I Played games such as Netflix FIFA, the new 2026 World Cup video game, FIFA 18 World Cup Mode, 2014, 2010 World Cup and even a World Cup game from 1986, the first ever World Cup Game. 

This is the fourth video in the World Cup Summer Series. 

I absolutely loved making this video and I really hope you enjoy it! Thank you for watching :) 

Follow me on Instagram! https://instagram.com/jamiefussell?igshid=OGQ5ZDc2ODk2ZA%3D%3D&utm_source=qr

snippet.title: Mourning's End Part II Unguided
snippet.description:
I wasn't lying when I said I've sunk hours into this idle game, (it's genuinely great) - let me know if you also enjoy it too! Download it here: https://idleobeliskminer.com/alienfood #ad

Welcome to Unguided, where I'm trying to complete every quest in old school runescape without using a guide, wiki or plugins. I'll only be using my limited knowledge and in-game learnings. Full rules below.

Watch the full Unguided series here: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZ1r83HxniSXUcxA2uRNHNWqyMDDRtUtZ&si=nNge3LpA1fqhdubt

RULES
- No use of OSRS wiki (or any equivalent) for anything - this includes looking up item spawns, quest guides, boss guides, anything
- No use of any other quest helper sites
- No use of quest helper plugin 
- Essentially no use of any outside-game assistance

CAVEATS
- I love OSRS YouTube, I might inadvertently learn something I don't know by watching my favourite content creators, but I'm not going to stop watching them so that's just a risk I'm willing to take + it's unlikely going to be relevant for me
- I may use some QoL plugins, but only a few. Loot tracker to prove grinds, ground items so I don't miss drops (and to add cool loot beams lol) and left click to use bones. Nothing that will give me info I didn't previously have
- I'm going to try and avoid any spoiler comments. If you can, please try not to help me if there's an episode where I'm stuck on something. I appreciate the sentiment but telling me an item spawn or quest step could spoil the fun :)

Music:
OSRS OST

#runescape #oldschoolrunescape #osrs #ironman #series
